# Anthropology Now

> > Anthropology Now is a peer-reviewed academic journal published by Taylor & Francis that explores contemporary anthropological research and contemporary global issues.

Anthropology Now is a peer-reviewed journal platform featuring original ethnographic research, editorial commentary, and curated content on pressing anthropological topics including climate change, medical anthropology, pedagogy, and multispecies ethnography. The journal is published by Taylor & Francis and managed by an editorial team of leading anthropologists.

## Featured Articles

- [When A Woman Is Married to Multiple Brothers: Land, Climate and Cultural Changes in Western Himalaya](https://anthronow.com/online-articles/when-a-woman-is-married-to-multiple-brothers-land-climate-and-cultural-changes-in-western-himalaya): Ethnographic study of polyandry, climate change, and cultural shifts in Kinnaur
- [May Your Classroom Be a Sea Change: Further Thoughts on Teaching about Palestine](https://anthronow.com/online-articles/may-your-classroom-be-a-sea-change-further-thoughts-on-teaching-about-palestine): Academic essay on pedagogy and teaching Palestinian displacement and occupation
- [Ghost Dogs and Their Unwitting Accomplices](https://anthronow.com/online-articles/ghost-dogs-and-their-unwitting-accomplices): Multispecies ethnography of urban coyotes and human-animal relations in Chicago
